The '''Fifth Deep Core Army''', also known as '''Shadow Hand Command''' and simply the '''Fifth Army''', was a [[Sector Army/Legends|Sector Army]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] charged with the defense of [[Sector 5/Legends|Sector 5]]. Headquartered in the [[Odik system/Legends|Odik system]], the Fifth Deep Core Army was one the GAR's six Reserve Sector Armies, and it was initially assigned to garrison the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]. However, much of the Sector Army was transferred to other, more active regions to support other [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces early in the war, and the 5th maintained only a skeleton force within the Deep Core.<ref name="EGW" /> Sometime prior to the [[Declaration of a New Order|founding]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Republic's successor state, on [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] (16:5:23), the Republic issued the [[Sector Governance Decree/Legends|Sector Governance Decree]], which gave twenty [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] command over one of the Sector Armies;<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> the Fifth was given to Moff [[Cinzero Gann|Gann]]. Gann was later elevated to [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]],<ref name="EGW" /> and he remained in power until at least [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]].<ref name="Shield">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref> The Sector Army shared its name with [[Shadow Hand]], a title indicating the second-in-command of a [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]], that originated on the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].<ref name="END">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/88/indexp2.html|text=''Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties''|int=Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Fifth Deep Core Army was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', a [[2012]] reference guide, which gave overviews of the twenty Sector Armies.<ref name="EGW" />
